summary: Configured /srv/drop as a shared writable sticky directory on node1 and verified persistence after reboot. CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created /srv/drop with root:root ownership and mode 1777.
Verified two unprivileged users could create and remove their own files.
Verified each user was denied when attempting to remove the other user's file.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed the boot identity changed.
Re-tested permissions and sticky-bit behavior after restart.

evidence.requirement: Shared writable directory with protection against deleting files owned by other users
evidence.summary: Shows /srv/drop as root:root mode 1777; nobody and daemon both wrote files, while cross-user deletion failed with Operation not permitted.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID d3dfad9f-1c03-4b70-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 88618636-13fd-4960-8000-000000000000, and successful post-restart permission and behavioral checks.
